# Explicitly disabled configurations cannot build an instrumented program.
env GOEXPERIMENT=noisolates
! go build -isolate-config=isolate.json .
stderr 'isolate config requires GOEXPERIMENT=isolates'
! go build -gcflags=-d=isolatebuild=1 .
stderr 'isolate instrumentation requires GOEXPERIMENT=isolates'
go run .
stdout '^ordinary execution works$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/disabled-isolates
go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main
import "fmt"
func main(){fmt.Println("ordinary execution works")}
-- isolate.json --
{"format_version":1}
